# Muntrume Motorsport (MMT)

> Engineering-driven iRacing sim racing team, setup vault, desktop sync software, and motorsport data platform based in Sant Andreu, Barcelona (Catalonia, Spain).

Muntrume Motorsport (also known as Equipo MMT) competes in iRacing endurance and sprint championships across GT3, GTP/LMDh, LMP2, LMP3, GT4, GTE, Porsche Cup, TCR, Formula, and Multiclass categories, while operating a full-stack sim racing engineering platform at https://muntru.me/.

## Core Platform & Tools

- [Garage Vault (42,654+ Setups .sto)](https://muntru.me/garage/): Searchable vault of 42,654+ verified `.sto` setups across 105+ cars and 150 official iRacing tracks, with interactive `.sto` setup preview modal, variant tags (`Safe`, `Endurance`, `LDF`, `MDF`, `HDF`), season/week filtering, and direct downloads.
- [MMT Sync Desktop App (Windows)](https://muntru.me/app/): Native Windows desktop application (Tauri/Rust, v0.1.32, open-source on [GitHub](https://github.com/ATM-Software-Labs/muntrume-site/releases/latest)) that automatically syncs team `.sto` setups directly into `Documents\iRacing\setups\MMT`, includes live telemetry overlay, iRacing path auto-detection, and automatic updates.
- [Official iRacing Tracks Directory (150 Circuits)](https://muntru.me/tracks/): Complete directory of 150 official iRacing tracks ranked by popularity (official series, setup coverage, free/base content, layouts), featuring 1,055 official track screenshots, circuit history, layout variants, and direct setup links.
- [2026 Season 4 Official Calendar](https://muntru.me/calendar/): Interactive iRacing season schedule with license classes (Rookie to Class A), Fixed/Open filters, car classes, and direct car+track setup matching.
- [Cars & Brands Catalog (108 Cars)](https://muntru.me/porsche/): Brand-by-brand and car-by-car technical directory covering 108 iRacing cars with studio previews, official iRacing PDF manuals, and setup counts.
- [Paddock & Race Radio](https://muntru.me/paddock/): Team hub with live race radio, Garage 61 telemetry integration, MTI (Muntrume Telemetry Index), official gallery, and driver tryout applications.
- [AI Race Engineer & Setup Builder](https://muntru.me/ai/): AI Copilot and custom Setup Builder for diagnosing handling balance, tyre wear, fuel strategy, and `.sto` adjustments.

## Team & Drivers

- **Headquarters**: Sant Andreu, Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain.
- **Founder & Team Principal**: [Alberto Trujillo (atrumin16)](https://muntru.me/d/albertot/)

- **Languages**: Spanish, Catalan, English, French (`?lang=es|ca|en|fr`).
